A280 Sharpshooter Rifle (V) is a Light Weapon (Character Weapon) from Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon.

Card Text

Deploy on your Rebel scout. During battles at same site, attrition against opponent is +1. May target a character, creature or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value. Once during your control phase, may fire using 2 Force.

Lore

BlasTech sharpshooter rifle accurate to 500 meters. Corporal Janse brought several A280s with him when he left BlasTech.

Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: Internet Archive

Chewie's AT-ST (V) is a Light Vehicle (Combat) from Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon.

Card Text

May add 2 pilots. During battle, if Chewie aboard, may target an opponent’s character or AT-ST present. Draw destiny. Target hit and power = 0 if destiny > defense value. Immune to attrition < 4.

Lore

Enclosed. Chewie’s daring capture of an Imperial AT-ST helped turn the tide in the Battle of Endor.

Tydirium (V) is a Light Starship (Starfighter) from Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon.

Card Text

May deploy (with a pilot) without presence or Force icons. May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. May forfeit a scout aboard to cancel all remaining battle damage against you.

Lore

Stolen Imperial Lambda-class shuttle. Supposedly carried parts and technical crew. Delivered General Solo’s crack team of Rebel scouts to the forest moon of Endor.

Lieutenant Renz (V) is a Dark Character (Imperial) from Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon.

Card Text

Once per game, if at a battleground site, may initiate a Force drain that cannot be canceled; Force drain is +X (this bonus may not be canceled; ignore other modifiers) where X = the number of unique (•) Stormtroopers at battleground sites.

Lore

Leader of one of the Emperor’s finest legions of troops. His command was placed at the disposal of Colonel Dyer. Always on the lookout for Rebel activity.

Card Text

Your unique (•) stormtroopers are deploy -1 to same site and are forfeit +1 at same and related locations.

Lore

Leader of Navy detachment assigned to guard the Endor control bunker. Liaison between Imperial technicians and command staff.

Sergeant Wallen (V) is a Dark Character (Imperial) from Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon.

Card Text

During battle here, your Imperial leaders may not be targeted by weapons. Your Imperials of ability < 4 at same site (except Galactic Senate) may not have their game text canceled or their forfeit value modified or reset.

Lore

Stormtrooper assigned to Colonel Dyer’s command. His unit was recommended to Commander Igar by Governor Yount of the Wakeelmui garrison.
